chassis.name: Scout Frame
chassis.desc: Tiny and light. Room for the essentials and not much else.

chassis.name: Standard Frame
chassis.desc: A balanced platform for most builds.

chassis.name: Hauler Frame
chassis.desc: Long and wide. Fits treads plus a full payload.

chassis.name: Pod Frame
chassis.desc: A little rounded pod. Squeeze in the basics.

chassis.name: Arrowhead Frame
chassis.desc: Pointed nose, wide tail -- plenty of room in the back.

chassis.name: Ring Frame
chassis.desc: A rounded ring with a hollow core; parts have to fit around the hole.

chassis.name: Disc Frame
chassis.desc: Round and roomy in the middle, tight at the edges.

chassis.name: Heavy Frame
chassis.desc: Huge and heavy -- everything fits, but moving it costs a lot.

sensors.name: Proximity Sensor
sensors.desc: Finds the single nearest particle within range, regardless of species.

sensors.name: Density Sensor
sensors.desc: Counts particles within a smaller radius; "detects" when the local crowd is thick, not just when something's near.

sensors.name: Velocity Sensor
sensors.desc: Detects when nearby particles are moving fast -- reads local turbulence rather than presence or count.

sensors.name: Sonar Pinger
sensors.desc: Sends out a ping every so often; senses if the ping comes back off a particle within range.

movement.name: Treads
movement.desc: Slower, but tolerates a heavier chassis without its power draw ballooning.

movement.name: Wheels + Servos
movement.desc: Faster top speed, but power draw climbs quickly with both speed and total weight.

displays.name: Status LED
displays.desc: A single steady/blinking light. Cheap to run.

displays.name: Halo Display
displays.desc: An animated spinning ring of color. Looks great, drinks power.

generators.name: Seeder
generators.desc: Drops a single particle of a random species. Cheap and quick to reload.

generators.name: Cluster Spawner
generators.desc: Releases a small clump of one species at a time -- instant little colony, slow to reload.

generators.name: Mimic Emitter
generators.desc: Copies the species of the nearest sensed particle (random if nothing is sensed). Pairs well with a sensor.

pulsers.name: Disruptor Pulse
pulsers.desc: Fires an expanding ring that destroys every particle it passes over.

pulsers.name: Lure Pulse
pulsers.desc: Fires an expanding ring that tugs every particle it passes over toward the robot.

robasicBlocks.name: Move Forward
robasicBlocks.desc: Move forward at the movement suite's current speed for the set number of ticks.

robasicBlocks.name: Turn Toward Nearest
robasicBlocks.desc: Rotate to face whatever the sensor most recently detected.

robasicBlocks.name: Turn Away From Nearest
robasicBlocks.desc: Rotate to face away from whatever the sensor most recently detected.

robasicBlocks.name: Turn Random
robasicBlocks.desc: Rotate to a random new heading.

robasicBlocks.name: Turn
robasicBlocks.desc: Rotate by the set number of degrees, left, right, or a random one of the two.

robasicBlocks.name: Wait
robasicBlocks.desc: Do nothing for the set number of ticks.

robasicBlocks.name: Emit Particles
robasicBlocks.desc: Fire every equipped particle generator that has reloaded.

robasicBlocks.name: Fire Pulse
robasicBlocks.desc: Fire every equipped pulse emitter that has reloaded.

robasicBlocks.name: If Sensing: Continue
robasicBlocks.desc: If the sensor currently detects something, run the next block this tick; otherwise skip it.

robasicBlocks.name: If Not Sensing: Continue
robasicBlocks.desc: If the sensor currently detects nothing, run the next block this tick; otherwise skip it.
